description: bin/ralph-overview.mjs:50-52 routes the 'cli' subcommand unconditionally to scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs, passing the remainder of argv (e.g. 'derive-next-command --task <id>') as arguments to the sync script. sync-ralph-state.mjs has no 'derive-next-command' subcommand and throws 'unknown argument: derive-next-command' on parse. This breaks the existing /work-on, /triage, and /blocker-report skills which all reference `ralph-overview cli derive-next-command` in their SKILL.md files (skills/work-on/SKILL.md:80,135; skills/triage/SKILL.md:90; skills/blocker-report/SKILL.md:102) and the regenerated Copilot mirrors under dist/copilot/. The v1.0.0 CHANGELOG describes the cli subcommand as a generic lib-CLI dispatcher; there is in fact a scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs file that should be the target. Verified by Copilot review.
suggestedFix: Change the 'cli' branch to dispatch by subcommand name into scripts/lib/<name>-cli.mjs (e.g., when args.rest[0] === 'derive-next-command', spawn scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs with the remaining args). Add a smoke test that invokes `node bin/ralph-overview.mjs cli derive-next-command --task TASK-1` against a fixture repo and asserts exit 0 + a JSON payload on stdout.
